request_id.description: Chosen by the client, unique among the collection subscriptions open on this socket: a `request_id` that is already in use is refused with `validation_error`. Every frame about the subscription carries it.

app_id.description: The app whose collection to follow. Required on the connection of a developer, whose token belongs to the organization and so to no app: without it the subscribe is refused with `validation_error`. On the connection of an app user or a server key it can be left out, because the token names the app; if it is sent, it must be that app, otherwise `validation_error`. An app that does not exist or belongs to another organization is answered `collection_not_found`.

robot_id.description: Only the records of this robot, in a collection that belongs to robots.

filter.description: Only records matching this filter are delivered, with the grammar of the `filter` of the record list but as an object, not JSON text. The whole frame is at most 16,384 bytes; a larger frame closes the socket with code 1009 (message too big) instead of being answered, so a filter with many long values may not fit.

description: Subscribes to the changes of the records of one collection.
